bibliography.title: Video-Based Optimal Transport for Feedback-Efficient Offline Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning

sections.title: D. Extended Discussion on Broader Context and Future Directions

abstract_sentences.text: Conveying complex objectives to reinforcement learning (RL) agents often requires meticulous reward engineering.

evidence.anchor: often requires meticulous reward engineering

abstract_sentences.text: Preference-based RL (PbRL) offers a promising alternative by learning reward functions from human feedback, but its scalability is hindered by high labeling costs.

evidence.anchor: scalability is hindered by high labeling costs

abstract_sentences.text: Inspired by advances in Video Foundation Models (ViFMs), we present Video-based Optimal Transport Preference (VOTP), a semi-supervised framework that learns effective reward functions from only a handful of labels.

evidence.anchor: we present Video-based Optimal Transport Preference

abstract_sentences.text: By leveraging optimal transport to align visual trajectories within the rich representation space of ViFMs, VOTP effectively generates high-fidelity pseudo-labels for large amounts of unlabeled data, substantially reducing human supervision.

evidence.anchor: align visual trajectories and generate high-fidelity pseudo-labels

abstract_sentences.text: Extensive experiments across locomotion and manipulation benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of VOTP, which outperforms state-of-the-art offline PbRL methods under limited feedback budgets.

evidence.anchor: outperforms state-of-the-art offline PbRL methods

abstract_sentences.text: We also showcase the robustness of VOTP in the presence of visual distractors and validate its utility on real robotic tasks, where it learns meaningful rewards with minimal human input.

evidence.anchor: robustness in the presence of visual distractors and real robotic tasks

abstract_sentences.text: The code is available at: https://github.com/tunglm2203/votp.

evidence.anchor: The code is available at

final_judgment.single_storyline: 少量视频 preference → ViFM trajectory embedding → OT forward/reverse alignment score → thresholded pseudo-preference → Bradley–Terry reward → offline IQL；核心创新是用 pairwise transport difference 传播偏好，而非直接让 VLM 打分（p.3–5, §4）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留问题、Eq. (3)–(7)、Fig. 1、Table 1、Fig. 2–7、Table 2–3，以及 Discussion/Limitations；这些对象覆盖机制、主 benchmark、组件/预算/阈值、visual robustness 和真实机器人决策（p.3–9）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix 放入 Algorithm 1、任务/数据/超参数、完整曲线、IQM/bootstrap CI、真实机器人输入、cost/human-teacher/pseudo-label accuracy/reward scatter/compute scaling（p.14–23）；主线更清楚，但跨任务机制与成本边界需读附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Eq. (5) 同时给出 R、OT plan 与 forward/reverse alignment 的可解释 score，Fig. 1 再用四个 labeled 和两个 unlabeled segments 做数值演示；公式、直觉和可复算图紧密相邻（p.4）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 没有 formal performance theory，也没有独立 intervention 识别 reward coverage → policy 的唯一中介；correlation、accuracy 与 policy score 形成支持链但不构成唯一因果证明。真实任务、人类标签、非 Gaussian policy 与大规模 OT 的外部效度仍开放（p.9、p.19–21）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对于少量标签加结构化序列数据的方法，正文应按同一因果顺序呈现标签传播机制、组件替代、标签预算曲线和失败/成本边界，并让每个强主张绑定直接图表对象（p.6–8）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 当传播依赖未验证的表征语义、数据分布非均匀或 downstream learner 只测单一实现时，只能把可迁移/可扩展写成部分闭环或 future direction（p.20–21）。
